_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ehl#6, and a correction to its Signal. The entry warned of 'silent scaling errors of 1e3-1e6'. On upstream ehl3d_mixed.4C.yaml (monolithic EHL, MAT_lubrication_law_constant VISCOSITY 4e-08, seven passing result tests) a 1000-fold viscosity slip is not silent and is not an answer at all: with 4C's default INFNORMSCALING the process is killed by SIGFPE, 'Invalid floating point operation', inside Epetra_CrsMatrix::InvRowSums called from EHL::Monolithic::scale_system — the row-sum scaling the entry recommends is what overflows; with INFNORMSCALING off the same deck dies instead inside umfdi_kernel_init in UMFPACK. Both give shell status 136 with no 4C error line, no MPI_ABORT block and no result-test verdict. An earlier draft of this fixture counted lines matching /unit|dimension|condition number/ and that count was not reproducible across runs, so it was replaced by the stable MPI_ABORT count. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: Signal code: Invalid floating point operation (7)
